lemmas.name: kth4
lemmas.statement: ∀ (arr : Array Int) (k : Nat) (h : kthElement_precond arr k), kthElement_postcond arr k (arr[k - 1]!) h
lemmas.proof:
by intro arr k h
  unfold kthElement_postcond
  rw [← Array.any_toList, List.any_eq_true]
  obtain ⟨hk1, hk2⟩ := h
  refine ⟨arr[k - 1]!, ?_, by simp⟩
  rw [← Refine.toList_getElem_bang arr (k - 1) (by omega)]
  exact Refine.getElem_bang_mem arr.toList (k - 1) (by simpa using (by omega : k - 1 < arr.size))
